reserveReview.rationale: New September 30, 2026 examination recovered from the issuer's current client-rendered report archive on 2026-10-20. Table 2 reports the whole NGN4,209,411,443.67 reserve book in rounded shares 48/28/13/11; Table 1 compares NGN3,953,275,819.97 circulating cNGN. Table 4 names CDS MMF and FAAM MMF. Table 5 includes three Nigerian Treasury bills and one OMO bill; Tables 6-7 retain unidentified fixed-term placements and bank deposits. Actual report dates replace August observations; no current holdings are extrapolated. Practitioner and management signature pages 5 and 7 are undated, and the report's public-release date remains unestablished. Table 3 omits the catalogued Lisk deployment, and note 10 excludes freeze/test tokens without quantifying whether any remain economically owed. The composition is retained as measured report context, not admitted whole-liability assurance or a current conserved bridge partition. No generic standing review may bypass the financial-report chronology gate. Bank identities, fund realization horizons and fixed-term maturity maxima remain unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: September 30, 2026 report reserve fair values: MMFs NGN2,034,720,389.88; Treasury/OMO bills NGN1,170,478,217.55; bank deposits NGN531,207,118.64; fixed-term investments NGN473,005,717.60. Source-reported rounded whole-book percentages 48/28/13/11 sum to 100.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four report categories are measured; financial-report admission remains withheld pending publication/signing chronology.
